digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite verification gate; code-review LLM-Review gate
propositions: HTTP 400 ValidationException ('Grammar compilation timed out' / 'Schema is too complex') occurs during Bedrock constrained-decoding grammar compilation when verification contracts with 22-36 optional parameters are sent as NativeOutput, triggering a 180-second Anthropic timeout

Commit 6c8daf7945 added an exact-model-id row setting native_structured_output=True for us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, causing rebar to send JSON schemas that exceed Anthropic's documented 24-optional-parameter complexity limit and 180-second compilation budget

The same failing contracts (plan_review_verification 31 optionals, code_review_verification 36 optionals) complete successfully in 7-12 seconds when routed to PromptedOutput or to native-capable models without the problematic override
Both Plan-review Pass-2 and Gerrit LLM-Review (code-review gate) are affected because both pin model=standard=sonnet-4-6 and both bind verification contracts exceeding the grammar-compilation budget

The complexity gate must recursively count optional parameters inside nested $defs and items, not only top-level properties, because VerificationOutput has one top-level property with optionals buried in sub-objects

Two independent stack-level failures prevent native structured output: variant A (Bedrock 180s timeout on grammar compilation) and variant B (botocore <1.43.64 rejects outputConfig parameter client-side in 0.0s), both must be gated before NativeOutput is selected
